items.title: Uganda: Uganda, Somalia Agree to Intensify Military Offensive Against Al-Shabaab
items.description: [Independent (Kampala)] Kampala -- Uganda and Somalia have agreed to intensify military operations against Al-Shabaab militants and explore alternative funding mechanisms to sustain security operations in Somalia. The agreement was reached during a meeting between President Yoweri Museveni and his Somali counterpart, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, who was on a one-day official visit to Uganda on November 23, 2026.

items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Somalia's parliamentary speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, also known as Jaamac, has accused Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda of colluding with Al-Shabaab, alleging that Israel had brought together the three countries, the militant group and forces loyal to former South West State leader Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen in a coordinated front against the federal government.
